items.what: Answer decisions on the page itself: an answer control on every open ask, block item and deck slide (pick an option or yes or no, add a comment, send). It changes how your word reaches decisions.b: today a record needs your words typed in the decisions session. Proposed: an answer counts only when signed in your browser by a key you published yourself (or one your pki.sgit.ai anchor operates); it is sealed to decisions.b and sent through feedback.b's lane pattern; decisions.b checks the signature and turns it into a signed record, citing the signed answer instead of a session event; a comment without an option is filed, never treated as a decision. security.b reviews first; a keeper of the decisions site builds it, not decisions.b's own session. security.b agrees with conditions (https://github.com/SovereignWebsite/Site__Agent__Security/blob/dev/site/decisions/opinions/2026-11-25__dinis-answers-on-blocks.json): only your pki.sgit.ai anchor counts on its own; a browser key counts only once your anchor signs a statement endorsing it, for at most 90 days, and an anchor-signed revocation stops it at once; you see the exact statement in plain words before signing; the record keeps the signed bytes. So after your yes, one more act of yours: endorse your browser key with your anchor
items.say: yes, answers signed with my own browser key on the decisions site count as my word
